work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CCXLII grants the provost and canons of Anagni cathedral violet collar, cassock and sash and the beneficiaries a black sash; LF52408 → LF52414 across page number LF52411; LF52473 → LF52482 across own provenance LF52476 and page number 358 LF52479; complete 30 August 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF52397–52397; the source closing at LF52486–52489 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die trigesima au- gusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
